description: The quit card (windows/quit_card.rs): the one dialog a close or a quit raises before anything goes anywhere. Local content, and narrower than the local windows': it answers with one command and it closes itself, so `close` is the only window permission it needs, cancelling this dialog is its own window closing and nothing else. `start-dragging` is for its header: a chromeless card is moved by the page, not by a title bar.
